newsitem.title: ITALY: Italian held in Rome with stolen Belgian passport.
newsitem.headline: Italian held in Rome with stolen Belgian passport.

text.p: Police on Monday arrested an Italian man at Rome airport with cocaine and a stolen Belgian passport similar to one seized last year that was linked to a possible international child smuggling ring.
They said Mario Bagnolini, 55, was travelling with three Brazilian women carrying a total of 6.5 kg (14.3 pounds) of cocaine in pouches around their waists on a Varig flight from Sao Paulo.
The three women were also arrested and charged with drug trafficking.

Police said the stolen passport, in a false name, was from the same stock as one carried by a Cambodian man arrested in Rome in December while attempting to enter Italy with four children who were not his.
Cao Leng Huot was charged with kidnapping and promoting illegal immigration in the December incident.

Huot told police at the airport that the two girls and two boys, aged between about six and 12, travelling with him from Phnom Penh via Hong Kong were his children but one of the girls shouted out that he was lying and was not their father.
He was also carrying dozens of photographs of other children and telephone numbers in code.
